title: Fake payment links in practice
intro: Fine, parcel, benefit: link by text? Stop. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Message from +994 51 000 83 17
decisions.prompt: A familiar courier name and a small amount. What do you do with this message?

body: TezKuryer: our courier could not find you. Pay 0.90 AZN for a new delivery: tezkuryer-catdirilma.example.net/odenis

decisions.explain: Report the text, then check the parcel in the official app.

decisions.title: e-xidmet-cerime.example.net
decisions.prompt: Look at the address bar. What do you do on this page?
decisions.explain: This is not the portal's own domain. Now open the portal yourself.

decisions.title: Message from SahilBank
decisions.prompt: Your bank sent a code. Look at the amount. What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: SahilBank
body: Code: 518204. Payment 412.00 AZN, TZK GLOBAL PAY. Never share this code.

options.label: Type the code on the site
Call the bank on the card's number

decisions.explain: The amount next to the code is far higher than the page said, so have the card blocked now.

decisions.title: e-xidmet.example
decisions.prompt: Is this page genuine or fake?
decisions.explain: This is the portal's own domain and you opened it yourself. This is where to check fines.

decisions.title: e-xidmet-endirim.example.net
decisions.prompt: Is this page genuine or fake?
decisions.explain: The domain is different and the page wants everything at once: card, code and SMS code. It is a theft form.
